_about: One record per run: one seat lease executing one Knot (or one campaign arm). Field groups follow research-2026-09/SYNTHESIS.md 'The unit: one run, not one token' plus the Correction (traversal group). Type words: string, number, integer, boolean, object, array, iso8601 (UTC 'Z' timestamp string), sha256 (64 hex), any. 'nullable': true means null is allowed BUT the group's null_reasons must then name the field. Validation is done by ledger_validate.py (stdlib), not by a jsonschema library.

identity._doc: Who ran what where. Everything the comparison engine pins (identity.json) is repeated here so a ledger line stands alone.

knot_id.doc: Knot this run executed (knot_lifecycle.py); null for pre-Knot runs

model.doc: revision = git sha; bytes = checkpoint bytes

runtime.doc: image digest pinned; engine = vllm | llama.cpp | ...

prereg.doc: commit null when the prereg was not committed before data (say so in notes)

clocks._doc: The clock starts at the capacity request and stops at confirmed release. All UTC ISO-8601. Each clock may carry a 'sources' entry naming where it came from and its precision.

t_request.doc: capacity requested (create clicked / API call / TUI provision)

t_work_start.doc: first recorded unit of work started

t_work_end.doc: last recorded unit of work finished

t_released.doc: provider confirmed the seat was deleted / released

rules: non-null clocks must be non-decreasing in the order listed

acquisition._doc: The denominator. Every provisioning attempt for this run, including failures. A listing is not an attempt.

attempts.doc: same shape as availability/observations.jsonl lines with method in {console-create, tui-provision, api-create, estate-lease}

work._doc: attempted / completed / correct / accepted / lost / restarts. correct means a frozen evaluator passed, not HTTP 200. accepted = correct AND within the latency gate (when no evaluator exists, accepted = completed AND within gate, and correct is null with a reason).

lost.doc: sent and never answered (timeout, connection reset)

restarts.doc: engine or seat restarts during the work window

cells.doc: optional per-cell breakdown for benchmark-style runs

sustained._doc: A recorded window in 5-minute buckets: minimum, median, and last quarter / first quarter of accepted per bucket. required_window_s is 3600 (Fable) or 7200 (Astra); meets_required_window says whether this run's window is long enough to count.

traversal._doc: SYNTHESIS Correction: every decode step is one weight traversal. Resident seats traverse HBM; streamed seats traverse a link. Each numeric field carries a sibling '<field>_basis' saying measured | estimated | null and how.

money._doc: Modeled = list rate x minutes. Billed = the invoice line when it posts (null until then). Credits are kept separate and never netted into modeled. Energy is for estate seats (metered watts x hours x tariff).

modeled_minutes_basis.doc: which clocks bound the modeled window

credits_usd.doc: credit consumed, as the provider reports it

energy.doc: all nullable inside; meter names the instrument or null

rules: modeled_usd == list_rate_per_gpu_hr * gpus * modeled_minutes / 60 (tolerance 0.01) when all non-null

derived._doc: Cost per accepted unit and wall clock per accepted unit. Computed from the groups above; the validator recomputes them.
rules: usd_per_accepted == money.<basis>_usd / work.accepted (tolerance 1e-6 relative) when non-null

receipts._doc: References to the retained bytes. Paths are repo-relative or absolute; sha256 when the file is content-addressed (cell files via MANIFEST.sha256).

items.doc: kind in {cell, env, env_normalized, image, manifest, log, serve_log, engine_output, availability, invoice, prereg, event_log, meter}

null_reasons_rule: Every group is an object that may carry 'null_reasons': {field: reason}. Every field in that group whose value is null MUST have a non-empty reason there. Reasons are prose, e.g. 'Run 1 did not record droplet deletion time'.
